content.summary: Engineered products manufacturer ESCO (NYSE:ESE) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2025, but sales rose 13.6% year on year to $296.3 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $1.09 billion at the midpoint came in 9% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.60 per share was 2.8% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
